<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindJob" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmed and application rated"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Interview" name="Interview proposed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Company wants you to work"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_FindJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="StartEvent_ReceiveApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Confirmation and rating" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmApplication" targetRef="ICE_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Interview" name="Interview proposal" sourceRef="SendTask_ProposeInterview" targetRef="ICE_Interview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Work offer" sourceRef="SendTask_SendOffer" targetRef="ICE_WorkOffer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job (Applicant)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StartSearch" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteApplication" name="Write and submit job application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApplication" name="Report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitMerge" name="Waiting for company or offer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitSplit" name="Next event"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_Confirmation" name="Receipt confirmed and application rated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Confirmation" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_Interview" name="Interview proposed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Interview" messageRef="Msg_Interview"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_NewOffer" name="New potential job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NewOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ICE_WorkOffer" name="Company wants you to work">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_WorkOffer" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordConfirmation" name="Record confirmation and rating"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review job offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteProbation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Job permanent?" default="Flow_OutcomeOther"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JobSearchEnds" name="Job search ends"/>
    <bpmn:dataStoreReference id="DS_CompanyReviews" name="Company reviews"/>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TA_ReviewVisibility">
      <bpmn:text>Reviews for a company can only be seen by job applicants after 1 year.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_ReviewVisibility" sourceRef="TA_ReviewVisibility" targetRef="DS_CompanyReviews"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToWrite" sourceRef="StartEvent_StartSearch" targetRef="Task_WriteApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToReport" sourceRef="Task_WriteApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_WaitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="ICE_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInterview" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="ICE_Interview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToNewOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="ICE_NewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToWorkOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="ICE_WorkOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToRecord" sourceRef="ICE_Confirmation" targetRef="Task_RecordConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToMerge" sourceRef="Task_RecordConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToNegotiate" sourceRef="ICE_Interview" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiateToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NewOfferToReview" sourceRef="ICE_NewOffer" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WorkOfferToProbation" sourceRef="ICE_WorkOffer" targetRef="Task_CompleteProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationToRate" sourceRef="Task_CompleteProbation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeEnd" name="Permanent and company rated above C" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="EndEvent_JobSearchEnds">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Job is permanent and company rated above C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeContinue" name="Permanent and company rated C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_ContinueOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Job is permanent and company rated C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeOther" name="Not permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ContinueOffers" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ReceiveApplication" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReceiveApplication" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ConfirmApplication" name="Confirm receipt and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Interview negotiated?" default="Flow_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ProposeInterview" name="Propose job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewJoin" name="Interview step done"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HireSplit" name="Company wants applicant to work?" default="Flow_NoHire"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendOffer" name="Send work offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Complete probation and rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Hired" name="Applicant rated"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotHired" name="Application closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoReceiveToConfirm" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="SendTask_ConfirmApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoConfirmToInterviewSplit" sourceRef="SendTask_ConfirmApplication" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="SendTask_ProposeInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Interview negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInterview" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProposeToJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_ProposeInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoJoinToHireSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HireSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HireYes" name="Wants applicant to work" sourceRef="Gateway_HireSplit" targetRef="SendTask_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Company wants applicant to work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHire" sourceRef="Gateway_HireSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_NotHired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToRate" sourceRef="SendTask_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateToHiredEnd" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="EndEvent_Hired"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: Follow the BPMN XML schema: never put a documentation element directly inside bpmn:definitions, and never nest a sequenceFlow inside a task, gateway or event. If you add an ioSpecification, it must contain its dataInput and dataOutput elements first, then at least one inputSet and one outputSet, even if empty: <bpmn:inputSet/><bpmn:outputSet/>.
rules.situation: the description orders several actions one after another within a single process, so the model needs a chain of flow nodes linked by execution-order connections

rules.instruction: When the description says that, while several parallel activities run for the same case, one actor also performs a separate action that is not part of those activities, and the later step must wait for this action as well.: Model that separate action as its own task on a dedicated parallel branch that starts at the same parallel gateway as the other parallel activities. Rejoin all branches at one parallel gateway before the later step that depends on them. Do not fold the action into another task or into the task that precedes the split, and do not omit it.
rules.situation: the description states that after a common step, two different parties must each perform their own separate action (for example, one party confirms and rates while the other party also rates or acts), with no choice between them and both required before the next step

rules.instruction: When the description states that a recurring obligation to perform an activity holds until a later decision outcome is reached, and that another outcome lifts the obligation while the process keeps running: Model the recurring activity as a task on the outgoing flow of an exclusive gateway whose question names the condition that lifts the obligation. Place the task on the branch where the obligation still applies, before the process returns to waiting for further outcomes. Do not place the task before the decision or on the branch where the description says the obligation is lifted, and do not drop it from the branch where it still applies. Keep the task label to the activity the description names.
rules.situation: the description states that a recurring obligation to perform an activity holds until a later decision outcome is reached, and that another outcome lifts the obligation while the process keeps running

rules.instruction: When the description states that one outcome ends the process, but a further rating or condition, checked after that outcome, lets the process continue, and a recurring activity still applies on the continuing path: After the activity that produces the outcome, place an exclusive gateway for that outcome. On the branch where the process ends, connect to an end event. On the branch where the outcome does not end the process, place a second exclusive gateway whose question names the further rating or condition. Put the recurring activity only on the branch where that condition holds, and loop that branch back to the waiting point. Do not connect the outcome gateway directly to the recurring activity, and do not place the recurring activity on the branch where the process ends.
rules.situation: the description states that one outcome ends the process, but a further rating or condition, checked after that outcome, lets the process continue, and a recurring activity still applies on the continuing path

rules.instruction: When the description states that, after a shared period of work, each of two parties may or must give an evaluation of the other, phrased as an action that each party performs (for example, one party can evaluate the other and the other can evaluate it back): Model each party's evaluation as its own user task performed by the party giving it, with one task per evaluation. Place these tasks in parallel after the shared period and join them with a parallel gateway before the process continues. Do not model the evaluation expected from the other party as an intermediate catch event, except where the description explicitly says the process waits for an incoming message or event.
